title: 1733 slave insurrection on St. John
text: The 1733 slave insurrection on St. John, also known as the Slave Uprising of 1733, was a slave insurrection started on Sankt Jan in the Danish West Indies on November 23, 1733, when 150 African slaves from Akwamu, in present-day Ghana, revolted against the owners and managers of the island's plantations.
